subject: IAM evidence collection & action plan for Stellar Nebula - SCIM/SSO/Admin
raw_messages:
From: Marissa Lowe <marissa.lowe@stellarnebula.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, procurement@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM/SSO evidence + admin control matrix

Hi Olga (and Redwood procurement),

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Stellar Nebula's security and identity teams have a handful of follow-ups before we can greenlight the POC. We need a compact evidence bundle and a quick action plan for the items below so our reviewers can complete the RFP worksheet: 

- SAML/OIDC metadata (IDP/SP endpoints, certificates) in machine-readable form
- SCIM attribute mapping and sample payloads for user create/update/deactivate
- Admin role & permission matrix (who can perform user provisioning, role management, billing)
- Recent SOC 2 snapshot (redacted if needed) and where audit logs for auth events are retained

Can you provide the artifacts, or point us to a shared folder? If you can attach initial files, we can start our internal review tonight. Ideally we have something by EOD Wednesday PST.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Lowe
Senior IT Security Manager | Stellar Nebula Inc.
marissa.lowe@stellarnebula.com

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700

Marissa — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Outline of next steps below so your team knows what to expect: 

1) Today: initial package with SAML metadata (XML), SCIM mapping spreadsheet, and a redacted SOC snapshot. (see attached)
2) Wed 11/11: Ben will provide a short video clip (2–3 min) showing the SCIM provisioning flow from Redwood Console + sample API call/response.
3) Thu 11/12: Kimberly will deliver an admin-role PDF with table-level permissions, RBAC grouping, and recommended least-privilege mappings for multi-tenant deployments.
4) Fri 11/13: Follow-up with any clarifications; link to a gated Drive folder and DocuSign if a non-disclosure is required.

We can also whiteboard the SCIM attribute mapping with your identity engineers if helpful — happy to schedule 30 minutes.

Attachments included in this email: redwood_scim_mapping_v1.xlsx, saml_metadata.xml, soc2-snapshot-2025.pdf

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Marissa Lowe <marissa.lowe@stellarnebula.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Admin role matrix and notes

Marissa / team,

Attached is the admin_role_matrix.pdf you requested. Key highlights:
- Roles: Organization Admin, Identity Admin, Billing Admin, Operator
- Provisioning rights scoped to Identity Admin + delegated group managers for SCIM writes
- Emergency access: separate break-glass account with audit-only tokens and time-bound approval required
- Audit logs: auth events retained for 365 days in encrypted log storage; export available via our console and S3 export on request

A couple of clarifications you asked about:
1) Can Stellar Nebula map SCIM groups to external AD groups? Yes — we expose groupId->externalId mapping and you can include externalGroupId in the sync mapping.
2) Does Redwood support claims-based OIDC role mapping? Yes, we support role mapping via custom claim transforms; I included an example transform in the PDF.

Attachments: admin_role_matrix.pdf

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Principal Product Manager, Identity | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Thanks — this is perfect. Two quick asks so our procurement can finish: 
1) Please add a sample SCIM deprovisioning event showing 3 concurrent attributes updated and the expected state after reconciliation (we need to show idempotency).
2) Confirm whether audit log exports include user-level token introspection events or only auth success/failure entries.

If you can drop those before EOD today we can wrap our internal review and progress the PO.

Best,
Marissa


-----Original Message-----
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Marissa Lowe <marissa.lowe@stellarnebula.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin role matrix and notes

Marissa — sending the idempotency sample and a short note on logs. See attachments: scim_deprovision_sample.json, auth_log_export_spec.txt. In short: audit exports include token introspection events (token_issue, token_revoke, introspect) when enabled; by default we capture auth success/failure, token issue, and revocation. Token introspection events are available behind an elevated logging flag (we provided process and hash redaction guidance in the export spec).

I've also added the gated Drive link and the DocuSign stub for your legal team: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c

If you'd like, Ben can run the short demo for your engineering reviewers next week.

Best,
Olga

Attachments: scim_deprovision_sample.json (text/json), auth_log_export_spec.txt (text/plain)
